author: Grant46
quote:
Perfection, absolutely magnificent graphics, smooth gameplay, charming music and characters...

You really relive Ocarina of Time for the first time again, with quality of life improvements.
A wonderful and emotional story that fills your soul and heart at every moment.

This game is and will always be immortal, 10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Grant46
quote:
A game that was 13 years in the making, ignoring the atrocious bugs... the main character is as bland as it can get, the only redeemable thing about him is that he's handsome, but other than that... he has no personality or charm, or anything else that's iconic and memorable.
Lucia on the other hand is worse, unlikable, toxic, a bad girlfriend... a terrible example of a woman, one that demands everything on a silver plate, while the man has to do all the work and not be appreciated by it.

The world is pretty empty and boring, for being such a massive world you'd expect more.

There's people who CAN'T be shot at, you already know what group I am talking about, so they're giving them a special treatment for some reason... and meanwhile, you CAN beat up old ladies, shoot them, and same with dogs, that's disgusting and not equal, if you're gonna restrict those actions, then you have to do it with everyone (either, you can kill everyone, or you can't kill anyone), simple.

No physical game, but they still charge you a ridiculous amount.

Extremely Overrated and overhyped game, would not recommend.

author: Grant46
quote:
Absolute Kart cinema
The Rivals, The music, The characters. The Speed...

author: Grant46
quote:
Don't trust the meta score, always check the USER's score!

This game is am absolute gem, if you love games like Danganronpa or Phoenix Wright, you will love this one.
Sure, the routes may be a bit too long (the whole game in fact), but if you have the patience to go through a lot of text it is worth it, this is a beautiful story, well explained and detailed, in fact, at the end I wished there was more, so I could stay just a bit longer enjoying this beautiful experience.

Hope this game gets the recognition it deserves, I wish everyone in the world could play this game and learn from it.

author: Grant46
quote:
World of Light is one of the best things I've ever played

Sakurai nailed the Fighter each Spirit uses, the music, the areas, it all matches the multiple themes of the games they're from.

And of course the fighting is addicting as hell, you keep wanting more and more and MORE!

Best Smash to date, it will be hard to surpass, but I hope they make an excellent job with the next one.

author: Grant46
quote:
It's simply one of the most beautiful and wonderful games I've ever played.

author: Grant46
quote:
Stellar Blade is an absolute masterpiece from start to finish. 
It has fast, smooth, and super satisfying fights.
It strikes the perfect balance between skill and fun, making it hard to put the controller down.
Visually, this game is stunning. The environments are rich with detail, the lighting is gorgeous, with poetic scenarios.
And let’s be real—Eve, the main character, is not only powerful and graceful, but incredibly sexy and pleasing to look at.
The music? Beautiful. Epic during combat, emotional during story moments—it fits perfectly and adds so much atmosphere.
The game is a must-play. One of the best games you can ever ask for.

author: Grant46
quote:
Absolutely overrated, they had an interesting idea, the beginning is good, but then they introduce you to so many characters that are not interesting and don't get enough development for you to care about them, the gameplay is horrible, and it gets even worst with the allucinations.

The game added too much unnecessary stuff, like those runes, and the characters, I'd be fine if you played with the blonde girl from the start, somehow playing through different eras in time, and explaining at least a tiny bit of what's going on over time.

author: Grant46
quote:
It's what every Final Fantasy fan has been waiting for, and MORE!
It's just a dream come true, not just one of the best FF in years, but also one of the best games ever.
I'd even say this game has multiple genres, cause with all the different  minigames and quests, play styles, exploration, areas... it's just has a bit of everything, and we LOVE it.
The music is one of the best in the series, they put a lot of work into it, one of the best aspects of the game.

And I already lost count of how many times the game made me cry, but it was at least 5, it's that incredible.

Game is LOTS of fun, top tier entertainment, MUST play and take your time with it enjoying every chapter, this is game of the decade in my opinion.

author: Grant46
quote:
I was hoping the story to get better at the end, but no, this game is total ****!!

The whole game was about getting reminded of all the abuse and bullying the protagonist suffered, and even worse, her small, cute dog getting killed, all because of an obsessed sick girl, WTF, what is so "beautiful" about this game?? nothing beautiful in this story!

This game was more like an slave simulator, you can't refuse playing along with all these ****, the only good thing was they were all killed by Stray Dog, Stray Dog may be my favorite character just for that, even with all his creepyness, at least he did Brown justice.
I got the "good" ending, but I still totally regret playing this trash, I should have stopped at "The Funeral" (start of the game), not worth it at all.
Do yourself a favor, and never play this thing, there are WAY better horror games.

author: Grant46
quote:
What is the definition of "cool"?
If you ask me, it's everything about this game, it's not trying to be cool, it is naturally freaking cool in all aspects
Let's start with my favorite, the MUSIC!!
Of all games I've ever played, this is the only one where I think all (or most of) the songs are a masterpiece, it is that good!
I swear that like half the reason I love this game so much, it's it's soundtrack, without it, the game would feel souless.
When you think you found your favorite song, then another one appears, and it is an absolute BANGER!
But, the music it's not the only reason of course
Let's talk about the characters.
At first we are introduced to a couple pretty normal characters  (well, Rindo looks pretty awesome for being your average normal guy (Thanks to Tetsuya Nomura awesome fashion design), then after the story progresses, you find some iconic characters that look much better than before! You can feel they have grown as a person, since the last time you saw them (well, at least most of them, but they still have their cool, fun personality).
The antagonists are pretty good too, expect some really epic battles with them, and I also prefer the Game Master from this game, but that's just me :)

I won't talk too much about the artstyle, it is and has always been wonderful since the first game, it is unique, it is his own thing and we love it.
The story may get a bit confusing at some point, but if you played the first one (including Another Day) and you read the secret reports from both games, you should have a better idea of everything that is happening, the Secret Reports are the deeper, untold part of both games I would say, pretty similar to Kingdom Hearts secret reports.

In the end, this is a game everybody should play, even if it's just for the fantastic music or the fun gameplay alone, like trying to collect all the pins and items, the replay value is high as well.
Square Enix did a great job with this sequel, making it even better than the first one in my opinion, and I cannot thank them enough, God bless everyone involved in creating such a wonderful experience.

10/10.

game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: Grant46
quote:
Not every JRPG can compare to this beautifully crafted piece of art, if I had to compare, I would say this is as good (or better) as Persona 5 Royale, and Final Fantasy VII Remake.

The story is incredibly deep and leaves you thinking about the meaning of life, and humans as a whole, it had moments where I had to get up and leave the room because I was too emotional and tears were flowing out of my eyes, the developers really worked hard on this game, to make it good for all audiences.

If I could rate this game higher than 10, I would, it's my favorite game of all time, and I will make sure my kids play it.
